title: BetaManagedAgentsCredentialValidation
description: Result of live-probing a credential against its configured MCP server.

credential_id.description: Unique identifier of the credential that was validated.

vault_id.description: Identifier of the vault containing the credential.

status.description: Overall verdict of the validation probe.

validated_at.description: When the validation probe was performed.

has_refresh_token.description: Whether the credential has a refresh token configured.

mcp_probe.description: Details of the failing MCP probe step. Null when the probe succeeded.

refresh.description: Details of the refresh-token exchange attempted on a 401. Null when no refresh was attempted.

BetaManagedAgentsCredentialRefreshStatus.description: Outcome of a refresh-token exchange attempted during credential validation.

BetaManagedAgentsCredentialValidationSta.description: Overall verdict of a credential validation probe.

BetaManagedAgentsMcpProbe.description: The failing step of an MCP validation probe.

method.description: The MCP method that failed (for example `initialize` or `tools/list`).

http_response.description: The captured HTTP error response. Null when no HTTP response was received (timeout, DNS, TLS).

BetaManagedAgentsRefreshHttpResponse.description: An HTTP response captured during a credential validation probe.

body.description: Response body. May be truncated and has sensitive values scrubbed.

BetaManagedAgentsRefreshObject.description: Outcome of a refresh-token exchange attempted during credential validation.

http_response.description: The captured HTTP error response from the token endpoint. Populated only when `status` is `failed`.
